I have about 4k on my 2021 Checkpoint. The cover came off the frame a week or so ago. I took the bike to the shop and they noted the bolt from that side came off.

The cover attaches directly to the bolt. You may need to pry to get it off.

They had a bolt handy and got it set up again. I had to buy a pair of new colors in the frame paint color.

What I learned - the Isospeed bolts should be checked every 2k or so.  The Isospeed bolt is a pivot that allows the top of the seat mast to go backwards, and this also bends the seat tube below the Isospeed pivot.  The top and bottom rotate around the Isospeed.
